about: VXU immunization updates modeled on a sample: one message (MSH to the next MSH: the patient, the order and its RXA administrations, the insurance) per member written, taken in turn from the sample's messages.
subject: members

message.about: The segments every VXU^V04 has (HL7 2.5.1): a dose given is an RXA.

units.name: member
units.missing: The sample has no MSH: no message to model members on.

derive.about: MSH-10, the message control id, is each message's own.
Each order written is a new one: its placer and filler order numbers (ORC-2/3) are its own.
